cause: The previous Besu public-key export used HOME=/var/lib/besu and created an empty .cache/JNA/temp directory, so the non-empty data-directory guard refused deployment.
audit: Only directories existed under /var/lib/besu/.cache; no files, database, chain data, or unknown material were present.
resolution: Remove the exact empty cache tree and unadopted temporary key, then use a dedicated /tmp home for key validation.
